items.title: Hedge funds are no longer just for the rich. They’re wooing everyday investors
items.title_zh: 对冲基金不再是富人的专属。它们正在吸引普通投资者
items.summary: Hedge funds are increasingly courting retail investors as the industry seeks new avenues for growth.
items.summary_zh: 随着该行业寻求新的增长途径，对冲基金正日益吸引零售投资者。

items.title: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
items.title_zh: 特朗普的最新关税举措如何使印度在与亚洲出口国竞争中占据优势
items.summary: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.
items.summary_zh: 根据各自的贸易协定，拟对孟加拉国、柬埔寨、泰国征收18%的关税，对中国和越南征收20%的关税，这为印度提供了竞争优势。

items.title: ‘South Park’ Season 29 Finale: ‘GTA 6’ Inspires Stan, Kyle and Cartman to Get to the Bottom of South America’s Power Outages
items.title_zh: 《南方公园》第29季大结局：《GTA 6》启发斯坦、凯尔和卡特曼深入调查南美洲的停电事件
items.summary: In the sixth and final episode of “South Park” Season 29, South America has once again been hit with major power outages — but this time it’s serious, considering “Grand Theft Auto VI” has finally been released, which means the residents of the mountain town will stop at nothing…
items.summary_zh: 在《南方公园》第29季的第六集，也就是最后一集中，南美洲再次遭遇大规模停电——但这一次情况非常严重，因为《侠盗猎车手6》终于发布了，这意味着山城居民将不惜一切代价……

items.title: Judge blocks FCC early-renewal process for Disney-owned ABC stations, for now
items.title_zh: 法官暂时叫停联邦通信委员会对迪士尼旗下ABC电视台的提前续证程序
items.summary: A judge has blocked the FCC's early license renewal process for Disney-owned ABC stations in 'important victory for the First Amendment'
items.summary_zh: 一位法官阻止了联邦通信委员会（FCC）对迪士尼旗下ABC电视台的提前续证程序，称之为“对第一修正案的重要胜利”。

items.title: U2 Salutes Dolly Parton With Recreation of Their ‘Torn’ Duet in NFL Thanksgiving Eve Halftime Show
items.title_zh: U2在NFL感恩节前夜中场秀上重现与多莉·帕顿的《Torn》二重唱，向她致敬
items.summary: U2 paid tribute to Dolly Parton as part of its halftime performance Wednesday night at the NFL’s first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game. The “duet” between a live Bono and a recording of Parton from last summer was the centerpiece of a highly promoted 10-minute set…
items.summary_zh: 周三晚，在NFL有史以来首场感恩节前夜比赛的中场表演中，U2向多莉·帕顿致敬。现场的博诺与去年夏天帕顿录音的“二重唱”是这场备受瞩目的10分钟演出的重头戏……

items.title: Now Google’s Familiar Faces AI feature works on Walmart’s $35 smart home camera too
items.title_zh: 现在，谷歌的“熟悉的面孔”人工智能功能也适用于沃尔玛售价35美元的智能家居摄像头
items.summary: A couple of Walmart's budget-friendly smart home cameras will be able to recognize people around your house now using Google's familiar face detection feature.
items.summary_zh: 沃尔玛的几款经济实惠的智能家居摄像头现在将能够使用谷歌的熟悉面孔检测功能来识别您家周围的人。

items.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
items.title_zh: 标普考虑因治理和“关键人物”风险而下调英伟达的信用评级
items.summary: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.
items.summary_zh: 该信用评级机构可能会将英伟达的信用评级下调至AA-，即第四高评级。

items.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
items.title_zh: FCC批准SpaceX将人工智能数据中心部署到太空的计划
items.summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.
items.summary_zh: FCC驳回了反对者提出的一些主要关切，包括对科学研究的潜在威胁，因为该机构认定这些关切不属于其监管权限范围。

items.title: ‘Love at first sight’: my go-to sustainable fashion brand is on deep discount for Black Friday
items.title_zh: “一见钟情”：我最喜爱的可持续时尚品牌正在进行黑色星期五大促

items.title: Maggie Goodman obituary
items.summary: Magazine editor who nurtured talented journalists and launched Hello! in the UK Maggie Goodman, who has died aged 90, was the first women’s magazine writer to interview the Beatles, in 1963.
items.summary_zh: 培养了众多才华横溢的记者，并在英国创办了《Hello!》杂志的杂志编辑玛吉·古德曼（Maggie Goodman）去世，享年90岁。她是1963年第一位采访披头士乐队的女性杂志撰稿人。
